summary: End-to-end validation of new Verification feature (documentos + consentimiento + fiscal + revisión interna). Backend: 13/13 tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_verification.py (upload with versioning, summary, history, download ACL, consent metadata, fiscal update, RBAC review matrix, admin consents). Frontend: tenant, landlord, superadmin and finanzas flows all pass. Only tenant/landlord (external), and internal superadmin/finanzas tested via UI. Consent already existed for tenant from prior run (consent-granted shown). Object storage upload works from UI (v4 shown after replace).

issues: Missing DialogDescription / aria-describedby on <DialogContent> generates a11y console warning (non-blocking).

action_items: (Optional/a11y) Add <DialogDescription> to AdminVerification review dialog to silence Radix aria warning.
(Optional cleanup) my_documents endpoint mutates docs to add days_to_expiry but doc_summary re-consumes them — fine, just note tests found nothing to fix.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1368 lines — verification block adds ~270 lines; consider splitting /verification, /documents, /admin/verification into a router module for maintainability.
download endpoint returns raw Response without Content-Disposition — browser will render inline (OK for images/PDF), but no filename hint is preserved.

admin_list_documents is gated by 'consultar' (broad) but should possibly require 'consultar_documentos_sensibles' to align with GET /api/admin/consents; today any internal user with 'consultar' can list all users' document metadata (paths still hidden but user_name + filenames leak).
MIME_TYPES check only whitelists by extension, not by sniffing bytes — a .pdf renamed .png would pass. Low risk given RBAC on download, but worth logging.
No pagination on /admin/verification/documents (limit=500) — will not scale.
consent-checkbox / submit-consent-btn once accepted cannot be revoked from UI (there is no DELETE /consent). Not required by spec but worth noting for GDPR-style compliance.
